decisions.reason: As a low-cost plugin close to the core shop offering, it still has option value because market uncertainty is unresolved and there is no clear sign of failure.
An ERP interface extends the firm's established implementation work and multichannel direction, so management would likely preserve this strategically relevant option absent negative evidence.

Although one of several similar tracking plugins and therefore somewhat more exposed to portfolio pruning, it remains close to the firm's measurable optimization focus and is still cheap enough to keep while demand becomes clearer.

Because it is another nearby-market plugin with uncertain but plausible client value, the firm would usually continue offering it unless overlap in the product set clearly outweighs its modest carrying cost.

The product fits the firm's analytics and traffic-optimization capabilities, and in a growing industry a young plugin like this would typically be retained while its commercial potential is tested further.
This reporting plugin is closely related to the firm's established services and likely inexpensive to maintain, so its remaining upside justifies keeping it on the market for now.
